name: dumbbell single arm chest supported row
description: A one-arm row with your chest braced on an incline bench. It lets you focus on each side of the back.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
